verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms RevenueCat serves an llms.txt at https://www.revenuecat.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary written for LLMs. Its docs are also published as per-page Markdown (.md URLs) and machine-readable product-knowledge JSON, and an AI Toolkit is documented for coding agents. missing for 10: evidence of the full llms.txt contents and coverage (only the header is shown, and the root docs.md returns 404), and community reports of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.revenuecat.com/llms.txt # RevenueCat
The RevenueCat AI Toolkit is what you install so your own coding agent can work with RevenueCat.
